method: Viewed all three standalone exact 4x nearest-neighbour crops beside supplied official logos; also viewed final portraits and rebuilt full board.

observations.codex: Eight visible rounded pixel lobes; blue perimeter separates lavender from chest; four bands and two-cell terminal strokes share a baseline.
observations.gemini_chest: 19-cell symmetric sparkle; only terminal cells are one-cell wide; concave sides and plump body; red/yellow/green blades with blue body and one transition band.
observations.gemini_visor: 9-cell symmetric plump sparkle centred at the original visor mark centre, with the same colour placement and no rim.

limitations: Curves use coarse 12px/13px logical cells; silhouettes are pixel-art approximations of the references.
